_meta.citation: GlobalNO2_AiT: 0.1 degree annual global ground-level NO2, Mu and Tao, Earth System Science Data 2026, Zenodo doi:10.5281/zenodo.13842191. CC BY 4.0.
_meta.why: NO2 is overwhelmingly combustion-derived, so unlike PM2.5 it carries no natural dust or sea-salt component
_meta.sampling: nearest grid cell to metro centroid; NaN cells widen to the nearest valid neighbourhood
_meta.limitation: centroid sample, not area-weighted over the boundary
_meta.precisionNote: 4 dp preserves rank order; this is grid precision, not measurement accuracy
